message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/934/figure_1a.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for parenchymal consolidation, mass, or opacity in the left lung fields to support localization and characterization of the finding described in the question."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/934/figure_1a.jpg", "reason": "To generate a natural language description of the left lower lobe/apical segment opacity, specifically checking for bronchial narrowing, lymphadenopathy, and border definition to differentiate between BOOP, TB, and atelectasis as per the options."}], "reason": "The question requires detailed morphological assessment (localization, size, relationship to bronchi/nodes) of a specific consolidation.
